fields.name: ReplicaId
fields.about: The broker ID of the follower, of -1 if this request is from a consumer.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: Each topic to get offsets for.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: Each partition to get offsets for.

fields.name: CurrentLeaderEpoch
fields.about: An epoch used to fence consumers/replicas with old metadata. If the epoch provided by the client is larger than the current epoch known to the broker, then the UNKNOWN_LEADER_EPOCH error code will be returned. If the provided epoch is smaller, then the FENCED_LEADER_EPOCH error code will be returned.

fields.name: LeaderEpoch
fields.about: The epoch to look up an offset for.
